evidence: the increasing use of time-shifting and advertising-skipping technologies that enable viewers to fast-forward or circumvent advertisements impacts the attractiveness of the Company's programming to advertisers

Other new technological developments are rapidly evolving in our industry such as the development and use of generative AI, including large language model applications, and the advantages and risks associated with its use are largely uncertain
Generative AI may enable new competitors to rapidly produce large volumes of content and replicate or imitate our proprietary content without authorization, attribution or compensation

Developments in technology increase the threat of content piracy by making it easier to create, access, duplicate, widely distribute, display and store high-quality pirated material. These developments include recent advances in AI and large language model applications

the legal and regulatory landscape governing new technologies such as AI remains unsettled and is an area of increasing regulatory focus. Developments in this area may adversely impact the Company s business, including through increased legal liability risk and compliance costs
ai_positioning.summary: FOXA adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA générative, percevant principalement des risques : concurrence accrue, piratage de contenu, incertitudes réglementaires et menaces sur ses modèles économiques traditionnels. Aucune initiative offensive ou d'intégration stratégique de l'IA n'est mentionnée.
